name: kneeling hip flexor
description: A kneeling lunge stretch that opens the front of the hip and thigh. Good after sitting or leg training.
instructions: Kneel on one knee with the other foot flat in front of you.
Place a pad under your back knee if needed.
Tuck your pelvis and squeeze the glute of the back leg.
Shift your hips gently forward until you feel a stretch at the front of the hip.
